_comment: UX.13.3 ratchet (CC-56): per target and surface, the median of 5 Lighthouse runs at one SHA. While a median is over its UX.13.3 budget the gate is baseline x (1 + tolerance) and the budget is a warning; a surface absent here asserts the budget outright. Lower these in every reduction PR; never raise them without a ruling. tbt_ms_slow (t_24fe7849, CC-56): the TBT baseline on the slow runner class, picked when the collected runs' median Lighthouse benchmarkIndex is below runner_class.slow_below; tbt_ms stays the fast-class baseline. Same ratchet: lower, never raise without a ruling.
tolerance_note: tbt_ms 1.0 as perf/lhci-baseline.json (WC-TW-6c-12): GH runners come in two CPU classes and TBT swings 1.35-1.61x at the same code.

runner_class.note: Lighthouse benchmarkIndex, median over a surface's collected runs. The class picks the TBT baseline only (lighthouserc.cjs runnerClass). Surface medians seen: slow 2204-2663, mid 2722 (Design QA 43360989289 attempt 2, booking TBT 595 > the fast limit 528), fast 2908-3056 and 3878-4208 (runs 43320245511-43360989289). 2850 sits under every fast median; a mid-band runner is judged as slow.
